run_dreambooth_lora_sd3_training: run DreamBooth LoRA fine-tuning on Stable Diffusion 3 with custom instance images and prompts
create_lora_config_transformer: create a LoRA configuration for the SD3 transformer with specified rank, alpha, dropout, and target modules
encode_text_prompts_sd3: encode text prompts using CLIP and T5 text encoders for Stable Diffusion 3 with pooled embeddings
build_dreambooth_dataset: build a DreamBooth dataset with instance and class images, applying resizing, cropping, and normalization transforms
save_lora_weights_sd3: save trained LoRA weights for SD3 transformer and text encoders in diffusers-compatible format
